formula: change ~ episode + n_previous + social_class + start_age + (1 | id)
notes: Partnership event-history data in person-period form: 'change' is the transition event, episode the time axis, n_previous and social_class covariates, id the person. 'partnership' (the current state) is the alternate response. (goldstein_msm/partnership.txt is the same file read without a header, excluded.) Hand pass #82: the additive formula is inferred. The primary paper (Table 2) fits change ~ np*(poly(episode,5,raw=TRUE) + start_age + social_class) + (1+np|id) from the first partnership onward, np marking non-partnership, with no n_previous effect; the downloaded state coding and subset do not establish np = partnership.
